habitat.name: Scenario Habitat (Lower Mount Sharp Outpost)
habitat.description: Fictional flat staging site in the lower Mount Sharp clay-to-sulfate corridor (team scenario).

targets.name: 2025 Curiosity Boxwork Veins Ridge
targets.evidence: Boxwork veins identified by Curiosity surface imaging (2025), hosted in the CRISM-mapped polyhydrated sulfate unit (~18-200 m/px).

targets.name: Gediz Vallis Sulfate Channel Deposit
targets.evidence: Hydrated sulfate spectral indicator in MRO CRISM MTRDR observation HRL0000BABA / FRT0000B6F1 (~18-36 m/px, PDS Geosciences).

targets.name: Marker Band Contact Bench
targets.evidence: Clay-to-sulfate transition bench documented in Fraeman et al. (2016) JGR-Planets & HiRISE stereo topography.

targets.name: Glen Torridon Smectite Clay Basin
targets.evidence: Phyllosilicate/smectite clay spectral signature in MRO CRISM MTRDR HRL0000BABA (brphyj browse, PDS Geosciences) over low-slope floor.
